lines.en: label iospring8:
scene noonsky
It was 5:43 PM on a Friday and the fabric of reality was tearing again.
lines.zh: 那是周五下午 5 点 43 分，现实的织物又一次撕裂了。

lines.en: Deep beneath the surface, where there are more hidden truths than ones we’ve unearthed, three young creatures that called themselves “humans” decided to try and piece things back together.
lines.zh: 在地表深处，那里隐藏的真相比我们已经挖出来的还多，三个自称「人类」的年轻生物决定试着把一切重新拼合起来。

lines.en: {size=-2}Only one of them knew how to sew. One and a half on days where the medication didn’t make the second’s hands shake. But what they’d quickly find is that the fabric in question is not the kind you can easily mend.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}其中只有一个会缝。在药物没有让第二个人的双手发抖的日子里，算是一个半。但她们很快就会发现，这块织物不是那种能轻易缝补的。{/size}

lines.en: And that no amount of textile work could make this place seem any more {i}real{/i} to them than it already was.
lines.zh: 而且，无论多少针线活，都无法让这个地方对她们而言显得比现在更{i}真实{/i}哪怕一分。

lines.en: Deeper and deeper they’d delve, counting grates that got worse at hiding the dark with light as the labyrinth pulled them further in.
lines.zh: 她们越钻越深，数着一道道格栅——随着迷宫把她们拉得更深，那些格栅用光掩盖黑暗的本事也越来越差。

lines.en: The tunnels hadn’t learned to reshape themselves yet, but they were trying — like wounds that suture themselves with time and hide the important bits within us.
lines.zh: 隧道还没有学会重塑自己，但它们正在尝试——就像那些用时间自我缝合、把重要的部分藏在我们体内的伤口。

lines.en: What were the {i}tunnels{/i} trying to hide, though?
lines.zh: 可是，{i}隧道{/i}到底想藏什么呢？

lines.en: And why was only one of these alleged “humans” a bit concerned at the moment?
lines.zh: 而为什么这几个所谓的「人类」里，此刻只有一个有点在意？

lines.en: scene iotunneltime1
: Just a little further, guys. We should be getting there soon according to this map I made.
lines.zh: : 再往前一点就好，各位。按我画的这张图，我们应该快到了。

lines.en: : I don’t know about this, Io...I’m starting to feel like we’re not allowed to be here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，Io……我开始觉得我们是不被允许来这儿的。

lines.en: : Yeah, ‘specially with all those signs sayin’ “Keep out” and stuff.
lines.zh: : 是啊，特别是那些牌子上还写着「禁止入内」什么的。

lines.en: : It’s fine! We’ve been down here plenty of times and nobody’s caught us yet, right?
lines.zh: : 没事的！我们下来过好多次了，从来没被抓到过，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...but I’ve never gone {i}this{/i} deep before. My stomach’s starting to feel kind of weird. Like, isn’t it {i}cold?{/i} I need a jacket. Let’s go get jackets and try again some other time.
lines.zh: : 嗯……可我从来没走到{i}这么深{/i}过。我的胃开始有点怪怪的。话说，这儿不{i}冷{/i}吗？我需要件外套。我们回去拿件外套，改天再来吧。

lines.en: : Maybe we shoulda just done that thing where one of us tries to toss somethin’ in from the top of the hole?
lines.zh: : 也许我们该用那种办法——从洞口顶上往里扔个什么东西试试？

lines.en: scene iotunneltime2
: That plan was Io’ed.
lines.zh: : 那个计划被 Io 掉了。

lines.en: : The heck’s that mean?
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思啊？

lines.en: : I think she means “trashed.”
lines.zh: : 我想她的意思是「扔了」。

lines.en: : Bingo. The locations don’t match up. I went back to the sinkhole last weekend to try and get a better idea of how it lined up with where we are now and they’re just way too far apart.
lines.zh: : 答对了。位置对不上。我上周末回了趟那个天坑，想搞清楚它跟我们现在的位置是怎么对齐的，结果它们差得太远了。

lines.en: : So unless this thing is like {i}miles{/i} wide, I’m pretty sure we’re dealing with a different phenomenon entirely.
lines.zh: : 所以除非这玩意儿有{i}好几英里{/i}宽，我基本可以确定，我们面对的是完全不同的一种现象。

lines.en: : I don’t really get it. But if you could teach me how to be this passionate about any sorta smart girl stuff, I’d really appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 我不太懂。不过你要是能教教我，怎么才能对任何一种聪明的女孩子玩意儿这么有热情，我会很感激的。

lines.en: : But if it’s {i}not{/i} the sinkhole and it’s a {i}different{/i} phenomenon, that makes it way scarier!
lines.zh: : 可如果{i}不是{/i}天坑，而是{i}另一种{/i}现象，那就更吓人了！

lines.en: scene iotunneltime3
: Right?! Isn’t that fun?!
lines.zh: : 对吧？！这难道不有趣吗？！

lines.en: : No! What part of “scary” don’t you understand?!
lines.zh: : 不！「吓人」这个词你到底哪里不懂？！

lines.en: : If you ask me, breaking into Sensei’s house was way scarier than this since we know for a fact that a monster lives there.
lines.zh: : 要我说，闯进 Sensei 家可比这吓人多了，因为我们确凿地知道那儿住着一只怪物。

lines.en: : Don’t talk about Ami like that! We’re probably going to kiss one day!
lines.zh: : 别那么说 Ami！我们说不定哪天会接吻呢！

lines.en: : Don’t! Ew!
lines.zh: : 别！恶心！

lines.en: : So, if there actually {i}is{/i} some kinda monster, what’s the battle plan? Cause I ain’t rollin’ over for no demon now that I know what an orgasm feels like.
lines.zh: : 那么，要是{i}真有{/i}什么怪物的话，作战计划是什么？因为老子现在知道高潮是什么感觉了，可不会随随便便就给恶魔躺下。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime4
: I don’t know. I guess we probably just die.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我猜我们大概就是死吧。

lines.en: : You’d be singin’ a different tune right now if you weren’t such a sexual.
lines.zh: : 你要不是这么好色，现在说的可就不是这套了。

lines.en: : Miku, let’s leave Io to fight the monster on her own and...go wear jackets and talk about orgasms together!
lines.zh: : Miku，我们让 Io 一个人去打怪物吧，然后……去穿外套、聊高潮！

lines.en: scene iotunneltime5
: Sounds like my kinda Friday.
lines.zh: : 听起来像我理想的周五。

lines.en: : Here! Straight ahead! We’re almost there!
lines.zh: : 这儿！正前方！我们快到了！

lines.en: scene black
: Come on! Just a little deeper!
lines.zh: : 快点！再往里走一点！

lines.en: : That sounds like my kinda Friday too.
lines.zh: : 那也听起来像我理想的周五。

lines.en: : Miku, you’re gonna wind up hurting yourself again if you keep talking like that...
lines.zh: : Miku，你再这么说话，又要伤到自己了……

lines.en: Further in the “humans” went, passing the last grate on the way to salvation.
lines.zh: 「人类」们继续往里走，经过了通往救赎之路上的最后一道格栅。

lines.en: But what they found upon arrival took on a form that none of them expected — especially the one who had already been here before.
lines.zh: 但她们抵达时发现的东西，呈现出一种她们谁都没预料到的形态——尤其是那个以前来过这里的人。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime6
: What the...
lines.zh: : 什么鬼……

lines.en: : Oh, good! Oh well! Looks like there’s nothing here. Time to turn around.
lines.zh: : 哦，好！哦，好吧！看来这儿什么都没有。该掉头了。

lines.en: : Under construction? Construction of {i}what?!{/i} No building needs a hole this deep!
lines.zh: : 施工中？施工{i}什么{/i}啊？！哪栋楼需要一个这么深的洞！

lines.en: : Ya think it might be some kinda earthquake thing? Or one of those thingies that hold a bunch of water in the event of floods or tidal waves somethin’?
lines.zh: : 你们觉得会不会是地震什么的？还是那种发洪水或者海啸时用来蓄水的大玩意儿？

lines.en: : We live in Kumon-mi! We’re not going to get any tidal waves over here!
lines.zh: : 我们住在 Kumon-mi！这儿不可能有海啸！

lines.en: : Hey, the beach ain’t {i}that{/i} far. I don’t know how big those things get.
lines.zh: : 嘿，海滩也没{i}那么{/i}远。我不知道那东西能有多大。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime7
: We’d {i}know{/i} if they were constructing something of this size, though. And the fact that they haven’t done anything about the sinkhole yet makes me doubt it’s {i}construction{/i} at all.
lines.zh: : 不过要是他们在建这么大规模的东西，我们肯定会{i}知道{/i}的。而且他们到现在都还没处理那个天坑，这让我怀疑根本不是{i}施工{/i}。

lines.en: : Like, wouldn’t filling that thing in be the main priority here?
lines.zh: : 就好比，把那玩意儿填起来难道不该是这里的首要任务吗？

lines.en: : Maybe...there was a second sinkhole? And we just didn’t know about it?
lines.zh: : 也许……还有第二个天坑？只是我们不知道？

lines.en: : But we’d see it from above ground and I didn’t find anything when I looked.
lines.zh: : 可我们从地面上就能看见啊，而且我找的时候什么都没发现。

lines.en: : Maybe you made a wrong turn or somethin’? Cause I ain’t great at followin’ directions either. Tried a new jogging route and got lost for like an hour the other day. Great exercise, though.
lines.zh: : 也许你拐错弯什么的？因为我也不太擅长看路。前几天试了一条新的慢跑路线，结果迷路了差不多一个小时。不过倒是锻炼得挺好。

lines.en: : What even {i}is{/i} that? It looks more like a...{i}screen{/i} than a sign. It’s gotta be, right? Like, who makes a sign that big?
lines.zh: : 那到底{i}是{/i}什么啊？看起来更像一块……{i}屏幕{/i}，而不是牌子。肯定是吧？谁会做那么大的一块牌子啊？

lines.en: scene iotunneltime8
: Maybe we should try and touch it to find out?
lines.zh: : 也许我们该试着摸一下，看看会怎样？

lines.en: : Great idea. I nominate Miku.
lines.zh: : 好主意。我提名 Miku。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime9
: I could try. Looks like it ain’t attached to the ledge, though. So you guys might have to hold onto me and make sure I don’t fall.
lines.zh: : 我可以试试。不过看起来它没固定在岩壁上。所以你们可能得抓住我，别让我掉下去。

lines.en: : I take it back. Please don’t touch it.
lines.zh: : 我收回刚才的话。请千万别碰它。

lines.en: : I agree. We don’t know if there are sensors on it or anything and touching it might alert someone to our presence.
lines.zh: : 我同意。我们不知道上面有没有传感器什么的，摸了说不定会有人察觉到我们在这儿。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime10
: Now, I ain’t no hole expert, but I’m pretty sure if somebody’s got the technology to put this thing here, they’re probably already watchin’ us.
lines.zh: : 我不是什么洞穴专家，不过我敢肯定，要是有人有技术把这玩意儿放这儿，那他们大概已经在看着我们了。

lines.en: : Miku’s right. We should go back, Io. Everything about this seems kind of off. And you’ve said before that there was a door thing over here, right?
lines.zh: : Miku 说得对。我们该回去了，Io。这一切都让人觉得有点不对劲。而且你之前说过这边有一扇门一样的东西，对吧？

lines.en: : Because all of this is starting to scream “evil government organization” to me. And it certainly doesn’t help that the new season of Stranger Things is still fresh in my mind.
lines.zh: : 因为这一切在我脑子里已经开始尖叫着「邪恶政府机构」了。而《怪奇物语》新一季还历历在目，就更不妙了。

lines.en: : This isn’t some stupid TV show where the characters age ten years over the course of like {i}one,{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 不过这又不是那种蠢电视剧——角色们在差不多{i}一季{/i}的时间里老了十岁。

lines.en: : Yeah. In fact, it kinda feels like we just ain’t agin’ at all sometimes.
lines.zh: : 是啊。事实上，有时候感觉我们根本就没在变老似的。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime11
: Ah! New Netflix show idea! Strangest Things! Think of all the money we could make! Those guys’ll license anything!
lines.zh: : 啊！新的 Netflix 剧集点子！《最怪奇的事》！想想我们能赚多少钱！那帮人什么都会授权！

lines.en: scene iotunneltime12
Confused and unamused, Io planned out her next move. Which direction could she take that might help her just to prove-
lines.zh: 困惑又觉得没意思，Io 盘算着下一步。她该往哪个方向走，才能帮自己证明——

lines.en: There was something more about this. Something sinister, corrupt. Who puts a sign inside a hole inside an empty aqueduct?
lines.zh: 这里面还有别的东西。某种阴险、腐朽的东西。谁会把一块牌子放进空渡槽里的一个洞里？

lines.en: And if she were to jump, would it reach all the way down? “How deep does this thing go?” she thinks. “Would I even make a sound?”
lines.zh: 而如果她跳下去，它能一直通到底吗？「这东西到底有多深？」她想。「我到底还能不能发出一点声音？」

lines.en: There was a struggle. A big one. Internal and unheard. The kind that makes her want to emulate the acts of cuckoo birds.
lines.zh: 有一场挣扎。一场巨大的挣扎。内在的、无声的。那种让她想要效仿布谷鸟的行径的挣扎。

lines.en: She’d get nothing in return. Not an answer. Not a word. No replacement for the thing she’d lost, nor the type of nest she most prefers.
lines.zh: 她什么也得不到。没有答案。没有一句话。没有能替代她所失去之物的东西，也没有她最偏爱的那种巢。

lines.en: This compulsion. This {i}fury.{/i} This stupid, lengthy, tragic journey- that ends in such a simple way it felt more like some duty’s jury.
lines.zh: 这份冲动。这股{i}暴怒{/i}。这趟愚蠢、漫长、悲惨的旅程——却以如此简单的方式收尾，简单得像是某种义务的陪审团。

lines.en: This was all for nothing. Just like {i}she{/i} was all for nothing. And the one thing she’d found in recent times that made her feel special was, in essence, also {i}nothing.{/i}
lines.zh: 这一切都白费了。就像{i}她{/i}这个人也是白费了一样。而她近来找到的、唯一一件让她觉得自己特别的东西，本质上，同样{i}什么都不是{/i}。

lines.en: What a letdown this became. So unfortunate. So lame. Guess it’s time to turn around and go back to retro PC games.
lines.zh: 这一切变成了多大的一场失望啊。如此不幸。如此无聊。看来是时候掉头回去玩复古 PC 游戏了。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime13
But then, suddenly, she noticed — from the corner of her eye — another body just beyond the bend. To which she’d question — {i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: 但就在这时，她突然从眼角余光里注意到——在弯道之外，还有另一个身影。对此她要问一句——{i}为什么{/i}？

lines.en: scene iotunneltime14
And so, suddenly, she’d vanish — and she’d leave her friends to die. To be swallowed by the “monster” as the bigger frog steals every fly.
lines.zh: 于是，突然间，她消失了——她丢下朋友们去送死。任她们被那只「怪物」吞噬，就像更大的青蛙抢走每一只苍蝇。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime15
They didn’t notice because they were dumb. They just stood and they stared as they twiddled their thumbs.
lines.zh: 她们没有注意到，因为她们很蠢。她们只是站在那儿盯着看，百无聊赖地转着大拇指。

lines.en: But I know something {i}they{/i} don’t know. I know what’s above. I know what’s below. And I’ll show you, I swear, when I think it’s apropos.
lines.zh: 但我知道一件{i}她们{/i}不知道的事。我知道上面有什么。我知道下面有什么。而且我会让你看到的，我发誓，在我觉得合适的时机。

lines.en: For the moment, I’d like to preserve some neutrality. There’s a time and a place to breach confidentiality.
lines.zh: 眼下，我想保持某种中立。破坏保密性是要挑时间和场合的。

lines.en: So enjoy the hospitality. Avoid some finality. And embrace or abhor all the forced sexuality. But keep this in mind-
lines.zh: 所以好好享受这份款待吧。避开某种终局。去拥抱或者憎恶所有那些被强加的性。但请记住这一点——

lines.en: Even the red string of fate can not repair this fabric.
lines.zh: 即便是命运的红线，也无法修补这块织物。

lines.en: But you know what {i}can?{/i}
lines.zh: 但你知道什么{i}可以{/i}吗？

lines.en: {i}Immortality.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}永生。{/i}

lines.en: scene iotunneltime16
: You! Stop! You’re that girl, right?! The one that’s always showing up at our events?! What are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : 你！站住！你就是那个女生吧？！老在我们活动上出现的那个？！你在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: : Did you follow us?! Do you know what that...{i}thing{/i} is?! Where are you going?!
lines.zh: : 你是跟踪我们来的吗？！你知道那……那{i}东西{/i}是什么吗？！你要去哪儿？！

lines.en: scene iotunneltime17
: What, are you {i}deaf{/i} too?! Come on! I know you were watching us! Don’t just walk away!
lines.zh: : 怎么，你也是{i}聋子{/i}吗？！拜托！我知道你一直在看着我们！别就这么走掉！

lines.en: scene black
Io wanted to run, but she couldn’t. Something about the air here and how it blended with the darkness kept her movement stuck somewhere near 40%% its normal rate.
lines.zh: Io 想跑，可她跑不动。这里的空气、以及它与黑暗交融的方式，把她的移动速度卡在正常速度的 40%% 左右。

lines.en: The thing with the air was the result of the same sort of invisible miasma exuded by the killers in classic slasher films that keep their victims from ever escaping.
lines.zh: 空气的问题，源自经典砍杀片里杀手们散发出的那种无形瘴气——正是它让受害者永远逃不掉。

lines.en: The darkness was because it was dark.
lines.zh: 而黑暗，则是因为这里很暗。

lines.en: Yet she scurried on like the “human” she was, trying to rapidly evolve in order to develop nightvision along the way and catch up with the child easier.
lines.zh: 可她还是像她那个「人类」一样匆匆前行，一边试图快速进化，好顺路发展出夜视能力，更容易追上那个孩子。

lines.en: Unfortunately, evolution takes time when you are not at liberty to create something out of nothing.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，当你无权无中生有的时候，进化是需要时间的。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime18
: Hah...hah...hah...
Which few people are, need I remind you. It is hard to become a god. Almost as hard as running underwater, which I’m sure it often feels like you’re doing.
lines.zh: 需要我提醒你吗，能做到的人寥寥无几。成为神很难。几乎跟在水下奔跑一样难——我敢说，你经常觉得自己就是在水下奔跑。

lines.en: And no, that’s not from miasma. Nor is it some vengeful sea god (which there are many of). It’s just how water works or something.
lines.zh: 而且不，那不是瘴气造成的。也不是什么复仇的海神（那种神可多了）。那只是水的运作方式之类的。

lines.en: I’m more accustomed to regular air, contrary to popular belief. Taking it. Giving it. Listening to how it sounds atop the roofs of building as I look out at the stars that decorate the skyline.
lines.zh: 与普遍的认知相反，我更习惯普通的空气。吸走它。给予它。倾听它掠过屋顶时的声音，而我眺望着装点天际线的群星。

lines.en: And when I see you all, you helpless, dysfunctional little ants, constantly exiting your death spiral to {i}search{/i} for things that do not concern you, I can’t help but get mad.
lines.zh: 而当我看着你们这些无助的、功能失调的小蚂蚁，不断地爬出自己的死亡螺旋，去{i}寻找{/i}那些与你们无关的东西时，我忍不住就生气。

lines.en: I asked for a castle and {i}this{/i} is what you give me? A mere {i}tunnel?{/i}
lines.zh: 我要的是一座城堡，而你们给我的就是{i}这个{/i}？一条破{i}隧道{/i}？

lines.en: That has always been my problem with ant farms. Once you reach the bottom, there’s nowhere left to go.
lines.zh: 一直以来我对蚂蚁工农场的不满就在这儿。一旦你挖到了底，就没有别的地方可去了。

lines.en: But wouldn’t it be {i}great{/i} if you could see what was beneath you? Or taste the sky on your tongue? Or do all of those things you never {i}can{/i} because you’re just {i}built different?{/i}
lines.zh: 可要是你能看见自己脚下有什么呢？或者用舌尖尝到天空的味道？或者去做那些你永远{i}做不到{/i}的事，因为你{i}天生就不一样{/i}？

lines.en: The correct answer is “no.”
lines.zh: 正确答案是「不能」。

lines.en: It wouldn’t.
lines.zh: 那并不好。

lines.en: Because greater things have greater fears.
lines.zh: 因为更伟大的事物，怀有更伟大的恐惧。

lines.en: And you should be happy with the ones you have down there in your farm.
lines.zh: 而你们该为自己在这座农场里拥有的那些恐惧而感到高兴。

lines.en: For they are {i}far{/i} less dangerous than what lurks below.
lines.zh: 因为它们{i}远{/i}不如潜伏在下方的东西危险。

lines.en: : Now...can we...finally...talk?...
lines.zh: : 现在……我们……可以……谈谈了吗？……

lines.en: : You’ve...backed...yourself...into a...corner!
lines.zh: : 你……把自己……逼进了……死角！

lines.en: : You have...nowhere else to...
lines.zh: : 你……没有别的地方……

lines.en: scene iotunneltime19
scene iotunneltime20
scene iotunneltime21
: Now, I ain’t no hole expert, but I’m pretty sure if somebody’s got the technology to put this thing here, they’re probably already watchin’ us.
lines.zh: : 我不是什么洞穴专家，不过我敢肯定，要是有人有技术把这玩意儿放这儿，那他们大概已经在看着我们了。

lines.en: : Miku’s right. We should go back, Io. Everything about this seems kind of off. And you’ve said before that there was a door thing over here, right?
lines.zh: : Miku 说得对。我们该回去了，Io。这一切都让人觉得有点不对劲。而且你之前说过这边有一扇门一样的东西，对吧？

lines.en: : Because all of this is starting to scream “evil government organization” to me. And it certainly doesn’t help that the new season of Stranger Things is still fresh in my- Io?
lines.zh: : 因为这一切在我脑子里已经开始尖叫着「邪恶政府机构」了。而《怪奇物语》新一季还历历在目——Io？

lines.en: scene iotunneltime22
: Are you crying? What happened? Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你在哭吗？出什么事了？你还好吗？

lines.en: : It’s just a hole! It’s no big deal. There are...others. We can find other holes!
lines.zh: : 只是个洞而已！没什么大不了的。还有……别的洞。我们可以去找别的洞！

lines.en: : You bring your pills? This another Yasu kinda thing? You ain’t gonna break if you don’t take ‘em right away, are ya?
lines.zh: : 你带药了吗？又是 Yasu 那种情况？你要是不马上吃，不会出什么事吧？

lines.en: : Uta’s right...we should go...
lines.zh: : Uta 说得对……我们该走了……

lines.en: : Uhh...I mean...we can {i}stay!{/i} I’m sorry if it seemed like I was scared. I’m not. Just...yeah! I’m not scared at all!
lines.zh: : 呃……我是说……我们可以{i}留下{/i}！要是看起来像我害怕了，我很抱歉。我没有。只是……是啊！我一点都不害怕！

lines.en: : Okay...
: But I am.
lines.zh: : 但我害怕。

lines.en: scene iotunneltime23
: Y...You are? But you’re never scared of anything. And just a second ago, you were-
lines.zh: : 你……你害怕？可你从来什么都不怕啊。而且就在一秒钟前，你还——

lines.en: : We shouldn’t be here...nobody should...
lines.zh: : 我们不该在这儿……谁都不该……

lines.en: : Somethin’ ain’t right with Io. Think she might’a seen somethin’ we didn’t.
lines.zh: : Io 有点不对劲。她大概看见了什么我们没看见的东西。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay. Well, I guess we’ll leave then. You’re sure? You won’t be upset? You’re not just doing this for me?
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。那我想我们就走吧。你确定？你不会不高兴吧？你不是在为了我而这么做吧？

lines.en: : I need to leave...
lines.zh: : 我需要离开……

lines.en: scene black
: I don’t want her near me again.
lines.zh: : 我不想让她再靠近我。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Just roll with it. I kinda wanna bail too.
lines.zh: : 顺着她吧。我也挺想撤了。

lines.en: : I-Io! Wait up! I don’t want to get lost in here!
lines.zh: : I-Io！等等我！我可不想在这儿迷路！

lines.en: It was 5:43 PM on a Friday.
lines.zh: 那是周五下午 5 点 43 分。

lines.en: No time had passed at all.
lines.zh: 一点时间都没有流逝。
